blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa should first be brought before a Philippine court if arrested, before being transferred to the International Criminal Court (ICC), Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson said Wednesday. According to Lacson, this will allow dela Rosa to avail himself of legal remedies in the country, including seeking relief from the Supreme Court, the country’s highest judicial body. “That’s part of due process. If he is arrested, he should be brought before a local court, placed under its custody, and allowed to seek legal remedies up to the Supreme Court,” he added in an interview on DZMM […]...
